exceptions.help: Call `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` once the object URL is no longer needed (after the download, in a `useEffect` cleanup, or on unmount). An object URL keeps its Blob/File alive for the document lifetime until it is revoked.
exceptions.reason: Every object URL is inserted in previewUrlsRef and revoked on media removal, explicit dialog close, and component unmount. The scanner does not follow the Set and cleanup callback.

exceptions.title: Loading flag reset outside finally
exceptions.message: This resets a loading/busy flag only on the success path: if the awaited call rejects the reset never runs and the flag stays stuck truthy (a spinner that never stops, a button disabled forever). Move the reset into a `finally` block, or mirror it on every catch, so it clears on rejection too.
exceptions.help: A trailing `setLoading(false)` after an `await` never runs if the awaited call rejects, so the flag stays stuck truthy; reset it in a `finally` block (or mirror the reset on every catch) so it clears on both paths.
exceptions.reason: fetchJsonResult resolves network, HTTP, and JSON parsing failures as result values. The mounted success/error branches converge on setLoading(false); there is no uncaught fetch rejection that needs a finally here.
